# Statement blocks of the rendering head that no test in cmd/dinah executes.
#
# TestEveryStatementOfTheRenderingHeadIsCoveredOrNamed reads this file. Every
# entry is a place the output check does not look, so an entry is a finding
# rather than a line of configuration: it says a block prints for a reader and
# nothing in the suite has ever read what it prints. Two assertions keep the
# pressure on. An entry naming a block the suite does execute fails, so a stale
# entry is pruned rather than left to accumulate, and an entry carrying no
# reason fails, so nobody adds one without saying why the block is unreached.
#
# A line is the block, then whitespace, then the reason. A blank line and a
# line opening with a hash are commentary.
#
# Two kinds of entry sit here and the difference is worth reading. Some blocks
# cannot be reached from a test at all, and say so. The rest are reachable and
# simply unreached: each is a human rendering the suite has never printed, and
# each is worth a test rather than a permanent line here.

help.go:137.32,139.3  verbHelp refusing a command it does not know, which runHelp settles before composing anything, so no invocation reaches it.
help.go:228.9,230.3  vocabularyValues giving up on a vocabulary source no listing answers to, which TestEveryVocabularySourceHasAListingThatAnswersIt refuses, so no declared source reaches it.
render.go:49.29,51.27  the stale outcome of a response, which the cli head cannot provoke: a stale revision needs a second writer between the read and the act.
render.go:51.27,53.4  the same, on the branch where the stale response carries a card.
render.go:54.3,54.102  the same, writing the stale sentence.
render.go:55.10,56.108  the unreachable outcome, which is by construction the outcome no invocation produces.
render.go:65.16,68.3  the branch where the machine form will not marshal, which needs a value the library cannot build.
render.go:113.19,115.3  a token the catalog carries no rendering for, and every token the head prints has one.
render.go:209.29,212.3  the sentence a listing prints when the state holds no card. Reachable and unreached: worth a test.
render.go:400.23,403.3  a card carrying a body, printed under its own line by show. Reachable and unreached: worth a test.
render.go:438.30,439.20  the reason a block carries in the history. Reachable and unreached: worth a test.
render.go:559.23,561.4  the states listing asked for before a workbench is open, which unknown-state cannot be raised before.
render.go:602.18,604.3  the composer's fallback for a refusal name no shape declares, which the source-side guard fails a build over, so no invocation reaches it.
render.go:644.23,646.3  a composition splicing no fragment at all, which needs a shape offering no next step, and every shape offers one.
render.go:672.2,672.11  the alternation answering with nothing, which needs a last member carrying a condition, and the guard fails a shape whose last member does.
render.go:798.23,800.3  renderWorkstreamLine handed no workstream, which emitWorkstream cannot produce: it draws the line only on an ok outcome, and every ok outcome of the two workstream acts carries the workstream it wrote.
render.go:830.22,832.3  workstreamRef reading a session that has opened no workbench, which no card line reaches: a card line is drawn from a response, and there is no response until a workbench is open.
table.go:241.30,243.3  the shipped binary's branch, where no test hook is armed. The suite arms the recorder for its whole run, so this is unreachable from a test by construction.
